label: Included
definition: At least one central passive learned fixed-label traffic task qualifies

label: Out of publication boundary
definition: Track or publication is outside the fixed archival venue boundary

label: Non-full publication
definition: Short paper, poster, demo, abstract, companion item, or other non-full item

label: No qualifying traffic input
definition: Classifier-facing population is not passive packets, flows, sessions, or traffic traces

label: No learned classifier
definition: Decision is rule, lookup, signature, hypothesis-test, or threshold based

label: No supervised fixed-label task
definition: One-class, unsupervised anomaly, clustering, or equivalent non-qualifying scheme

label: Classification ancillary
definition: Classification is not a central contribution or central evaluated task

label: Rule, lookup, or DPI only
definition: Rule, lookup, signature, or DPI-only decision

label: Active probing
definition: Classifier depends on deliberately elicited remote responses

label: Defense or obfuscation
definition: Defense, obfuscation, or mitigation without a separable qualifying task

label: Adversarial or generative support
definition: Adversarial generation or traffic generation with only support classification

label: Pure multilabel task
definition: No qualifying mutually exclusive label scheme

label: Operational or support label
definition: Transport, routing, measurement, or other operational label

label: Non-primary classifier study
definition: Survey, SoK, replication, dataset, benchmark, or framework without a central qualifier

label: Insufficient authoritative text
definition: Paper-level eligibility cannot be resolved from authoritative text or metadata
